svg.title: Model card automation
svg.desc: Notebook or pipeline registration creates or updates a SageMaker Model Package. EventBridge invokes Lambda, which enriches the model card on that same package version and exits without writing when the card already matches.
svg.text: Keep each Model Package card aligned with approval state
UpdateModelPackage: enrich the card or align ModelCardStatus
The update emits another event; Lambda performs no write when the card already matches.
